title: In a family
source: User-provided workbook photo, visible table manually transcribed; illustrated family translations suggested separately

entries.example: My auntie arrived first.
entries.description: A friendly word for your mum's or dad's sister

entries.example: It's difficult for me to stay calm.
entries.description: Quiet and relaxed, not nervous or angry

entries.example: My dad has a new girlfriend.
entries.description: A girl or woman who someone is in love with and goes out with

entries.example: I'm very proud of myself.
entries.description: To feel very happy about what you or someone else did

entries.example: We've got the same sense of humour.
entries.description: You have this if you laugh at jokes and make them too

entries.example: Your hat's so ugly!
entries.description: The opposite of beautiful

entries.example: I've got this virus.
entries.description: A very small thing that can make you ill, like the flu

entries.example: I like to breathe the clean air in the mountains.
entries.description: To take air in and out of your body

entries.example: You can burn wood on a fire.
entries.description: What fire does to wood or paper

entries.example: She doesn't speak a foreign language.
entries.description: French or Spanish for Austrian children: not their mother tongue

entries.example: When you get scared, try not to panic.
entries.description: To get very scared and not think clearly

entries.example: The farmer has a big tractor on his farm.
entries.description: A farmer drives this big vehicle on the fields

entries.example: You use a tool to make or build something.

entries.description: To be in the same family as someone

entries.description: Open to everybody, not private
